text: Why does the Lorenz system at rho = 28 never settle into steady convection?
choices: The Lorenz system has no fixed points for rho = 28
The convective fixed points C+/- are stable attractors, so the trajectory oscillates between them periodically
The dynamics are stochastic, so no steady state can exist
All three fixed points (the origin C0 and the pair C+/-) are unstable, forcing perpetual aperiodic wandering
explanation: At rho = 28 the origin has lost stability and C+/- are unstable spirals, so all three fixed points are unstable and the trajectory can never rest, wandering aperiodically on the strange attractor. C+/- are not stable (option 1), the system does have fixed points, and it is fully deterministic.
